rationale.regulatory-compliance: Frames agentic software oversight around operationalizing EU AI Act mandates.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Synthesizes intervention-point, control-allocation, and human-authority gaps in agentic workflows.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Identifies interpretability and adaptive explanations as prerequisites for effective oversight.
rationale.org-governance: Centers governance-by-design, accountability roles, auditing, and scalable organizational controls.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Calls for persistent activity logs enabling retrospective review and responsibility attribution.
rationale.lit-review: Multivocal review synthesizes fifteen academic and grey-literature sources.

rationale.counterpoint: Opposes plug-and-play automation and argues autonomy demands stronger human oversight.

rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally analyzes automation bias, deskilling, cognitive overload, and trust calibration.
